instruction.text: Find all the informal vocabulary in the letter.

atoms.b:
((Hi there)),

I am ((just giving you a heads up)) about your ((brainwave)) to test your products against animals. I would like to ((well, shout at you!)) because I believe it is absolutely ((gross)) and a violation of animal rights. I demand that you ((go check out)) your practices and ((have a good old think about)) how you ((cook up)) your products. I hope that you deal with the ((prob)) as ((rapid)) as possible and I ((can’t wait)) to receive a ((text back)) from you.

((Cheers)),
Kyle
